node.statement: Notation and nonemptiness: set F={f: ||p_f-p_v||_1 >= rho}, w_f=max(P_vf,0), nu_v=sum_j max(-P_vj,0), and L_F=sum_{f in F} w_f. The hypothesis L_F>0 implies that F contains at least one index with w_f>0, so the far-row minimum in def-exposed is over a nonempty set and min_{f in F} h(p_f) <= min_{f in F, w_f>0} h(p_f) for every admissible exposer h.
